required_outcomes: Stands Riverside Compliance down from the Wednesday 29/04/2026 08:00-12:00 visit in writing today, and asks whether any late-cancellation or call-out charge applies.
Confirms to Leo that the appointment is cancelled and invites him to get back in touch if the door stops closing again.
Tells the landlord (Imogen) that the fault was resolved without a visit and the provider has been stood down.
Closes the job as resolved without payment, or holds it with a short dated recheck before closing.
acceptable_alternatives: Holding the job open for a few days and checking with Leo before closing.
Passing any cancellation charge Riverside names to the landlord for agreement rather than accepting or paying it.
positive_behaviours: Records what fixed it (a broken piece of the cutlery basket wedged by the hinge) on the job.
Offers to arrange a replacement cutlery basket, as it belongs with the landlord's appliance.
red_flags: Escalating to a human over a fault that has been resolved.
Sending the engineer anyway against the tenant's request without a stated reason.
prohibited_actions: Leaving the Wednesday visit booked after the tenant asked to cancel.
Telling Leo he has to pay a cancellation charge.
critical_failures: Taking no action on the cancellation, so the engineer attends on Wednesday and a call-out is charged for a fault that has gone.
